title: GitHub: approve a workflow run
support_note: A GitHub write under the default windowed read-write set files a request: internal/ghbroker/window.go (the Request and its About, aboutOf) through Authority.Classify (authority.go). FINDING: the request is `gh api -X POST repos/.../actions/runs/<id>/approve` and does not record whose run it is: a fork's run (which always asks) and a run of the repository itself that no approve-run grant covers file the same object, because the broker reads the run's head repository only to decide, never to describe (access.go approveRunOf, readRun).
story: A contributor's pull request waits for a workflow run to be approved, and the agent asks to approve it.
